ScenarioDef.label: Starfleet Shuttle Start
ScenarioDef.description:
Starfleet Command has flagged a small neutral zone world for a routine surface survey.
 Admiral April is dispatching a Lieutenant, junior grade, with four Starfleet cadets to
 execute a low-footprint away mission:
 establish a perimeter, deploy subspace sensors, and investigate reports of ancient alien obelisks detected from orbit.
 This is a training-grade operation with real stakes. Expect limited resupply and no starship air cover once the shuttle departs.
 Maintain Prime Directive discipline—observe, sample, and document without unnecessary cultural impact.
 Defensive force is authorized if local conditions deteriorate.
 Mission objectives:
 1. Insert by shuttle and secure a small operating zone.
 2. Deploy the subspace sensor array near the suspected obelisk sites.
 3. Complete paired scans and transmit telemetry to Starfleet.
 4. Hold the area against wildlife agitation and opportunistic claimants until extraction.
 Caution: subspace harmonics can agitate native fauna and may draw attention from scavengers—or trigger legacy defenses around any genuine relics.
 Treat all unknown technology with care, and bring everyone home.

scenario.summary: Admiral April assigns a junior lieutenant (LtJG) and four Starfleet cadets to their first away mission:\n a routine survey within the neutral zone, where orbital telemetry hints at ancient alien artifacts.

li.text:
Welcome to your first Starfleet away mission Lieutenant Junior Grad.
 You are leading a team of four cadets on a surface survey of a neutral zone world.
 Your objectives are to establish a perimeter, deploy subspace sensors,
 and investigate ancient alien obelisks detected from orbit.
 Maintain Prime Directive discipline and be prepared for limited resupply
 and no starship air cover once the shuttle departs.
 Defensive force is authorized if local conditions deteriorate.
 Treat all unknown technology with care.
 Good luck Lieutenant JG, Admiral Robert April.
